paper.title_en: Study of neutrino spin oscillations in a gravitational field with a differential equations method
paper.abstract_en: In this work, we employ Ordinary Differential Equation solution method to study neutrino spin oscillations in the case when they are gravitationally scattered off a rotating Kerr black hole. Previously, this problem involved the integral solution of the Hamilton-Jacobi equation. We analyze the consistency of these two methods.
paper.journal_ref: Physics of Particles and Nuclei, 2026, Vol. 57, No. 5, pp. 1191-1196
